definitions.gloss: Arabia; the Arabian Peninsula; Arabic, Arabian
definitions.explanation: The Arabian Peninsula and, as the first part of compounds, the Arab world and its language: アラビア{語|ご} (Arabic), アラビア{数字|すうじ} (Arabic numerals).

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アラビア{数字|すうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the prices in Arabic numerals.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、アラビアンナイト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧で⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I was absorbed in the stories of the Arabian Nights.

notes:
Mostly met as the first half of a compound. In Japanese writing, アラビア{数字|すうじ} (1, 2, 3) contrasts with ⟦{漢数字|かんすうじ}→漢数字：28128_kansuuji⟧ (⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧, ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧, ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧), and forms and style guides often say which to use.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- アラビア⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧: Arabic (language)
- アラビア{数字|すうじ}: Arabic numerals
- アラビア⟦{半島|はんとう}→半島：04333_hantou⟧: the Arabian Peninsula
- アラビアンナイト: the Arabian Nights

RELATED WORDS:
- アラブ: Arab (people, countries: アラブ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧)
- ⟦{中東|ちゅうとう}→中東：17924_chuutou⟧: the Middle East
